column3: Close to the Hebrew; “O arrogance” is rendered “O most haughty one,” and “I will visit you” “I will punish you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “arrogance” is rendered “The most proud.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the earth” is rendered “the land.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the empty talkers” is rendered “the soothsayers,” and “shattered” “dismayed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “every foreigner” is rendered “all the mixed peoples.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they act like mad people in the terrors” is rendered “they are insane with their idols.”
Close to the Hebrew; “desert creatures with hyenas” is rendered “the wild desert beasts … with the jackals,” and “daughters of the ostrich” “the ostriches.”
Close to the Hebrew; “javelin” is rendered “lance.”

NKJV renders “to the pasture of an ever-flowing stream” as “Against the dwelling place of the strong,” turns “whoever is chosen I will appoint over it” into a question, and renders “summon me” as “arraign Me.”
NKJV makes “the least of the flock” the subject (“shall draw them out”) and renders “he will devastate the pasture” as “He will make their dwelling place desolate with them.”
